weltlauf.text: The CalcioM module in the game writes all player and club records to a file. CalcioM then re-imports by itself. The game must be running and your Master League loaded.
weltlauf.frage.text:
For this, CalcioM switches on the world file of the CalcioM module in the add-on folder and switches it off again after the import. Your save game is not changed.

Start the game, load the Master League and stay in the menu. Do not advance a day or start a match until CalcioM reports it is done.

karriere.frage.text: If you have only changed club or loaded an older save game, choose "Same career": then you simply carry on. With a new club, confidence, fan mood and season objective start afresh. With "New career" everything from the previous career moves to the archive, such as messages, promises and morale, and you start from scratch. Nothing is deleted. Until you decide, nothing new is added.
